scope: FNG-ITER shutdown-dose benchmark evidence required by VAL-023; access review only, no validation result

sources.observation: The record provides a public research archive; its displayed License field is empty.

Bounded read-only inspection found 49 members and 34,115,449 expanded bytes. models/fng_dose/experiment.txt has 1,964 two-column numeric records plotted as experiment by figures/plot_fng_results.py. No per-point uncertainty columns, README, license, or data provenance statement were found. No benchmark values are included in this record.

The public SINBAD v2 Volume 1 terms specify organization/intended-use-bound single-user access and prohibit dataset redistribution. Article 4 distinguishes outputs that no longer contain the dataset. These terms supersede relying on the historical v1 output-language concern in the release plan; this review does not establish a license for the Zenodo deposit.
The inspected CoNDERC index identifies FNG streaming data; a complete FNG shutdown-dose measurement series with experimental error bars was not located there.

remaining_evidence: Source provenance and permitted use of the public experimental curve
Experimental uncertainty and confidence convention at every required published cooling time
Registered benchmark case, matched irradiation/location/source definitions, decay-photon cross-check, and actual scored transport evidence
conclusion: Numerical experimental data is publicly accessible. The complete provenance/uncertainty/permission basis needed for the required scoped benchmark has not been obtained or verified. This is not a claim that public measurements do not exist.
